notes: Form 425 filing: an 8-K (doc seq=1) announcing the 2021-04-26 Agreement and Plan of Merger between RMR Mortgage Trust (RMRM, surviving entity) and Tremont Mortgage Trust (TRMT). Exchange ratio 0.52 is stated in the text, no arithmetic. Filer described as a mortgage REIT (the filing says it was an investment company before 2021-01-05); fund_type set to reit. Only RMRM is printed as an exchange ticker; TRMT is the filing's abbreviation for Tremont Mortgage Trust, so subject_tickers is uncertain. cash_per_share is null (cash is only for fractional shares). collar is null: the filing says the ratio is fixed and not adjusted to market prices, but does not use the word collar. Meeting and record dates are not stated in the excerpt. The excerpt ends inside the TRMT representations (Exhibit 2.1), so later terms are not in front of me.
